plugins.name: eachlabs
plugins.description: Generate and edit images, video, music and voice with each::labs models, and run your organization's each::labs workflows, from a conversation. Cut, crop, resize and convert media, and pick files, settings and variants on interactive cards inside the chat. Sign in with your each::labs account; no API key needed.
